name: Cedar Soft Furnishings
description: Soft furnishings specialist. Discount warehouse: some of the lowest prices in town, plain finishes, no frills. We carry mirrors, sofas.
skill_description: We sell mirrors, sofas, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
